body.p: Last summer. An old man Selkup lives alone. At some point his little tent wanted to jump out from under him. A huge hairy old man appeared in the door. He said: "Selkup old man, let me live with you." The old man said: "Well, live!" The old Selkup usually gets a lot of fish, but to tell the truth, nothing gets into his mouth, his huge hairy man eats all the fish. The giant sometimes works: sometimes he brings water, sometimes he brings firewood. During the summer the giant asks: "Selkup old man, what is your name?" The Selkup old man answers: "My name is Last summer, Last summer." Autumn came. The Selkup old man's prey became poor. The giant frequently says to him: "Old man, I will eat you." The Selkup old man had a huge copper culdron of chopped fish bellies. He took it out. The giant drank the soup of fish bellies at once, only a bit left. The Selkup old man said to the giant: "The hairy one, let me pour the remaining fish bellies into your mouth." The giant replied:"Pour it out, pour it out." The Selkup old man started pouring out the rest, but suddenly put the huge copper cauldron on the head of the hairy man, also hit him in the head with an axe and ran away himself. The giant's cry is horrible. Hearing his cry, seven huge men came. They ask him: "Well, say, who did this to you?" "Last summer, last summer." "And what did you do when people did that to you, how did you behave?" "Where will we find now people who left last summer, they have already gone far away."
